t: 航海家亨利被任命为基督会会长.
te: Henry the Navigator is appointed governor of the Order of Christ.
dz: 航海家亨利被任命为基督会会长.
de: Henry the Navigator is appointed governor of the Order of Christ.

t: 威尼斯共和国军队攻克了乌丁,结束了帕特里亚德弗里利人的独立.
te: Troops of the Republic of Venice capture Udine, ending the independence of the Patria del Friuli.
dz: 威尼斯共和国军队攻克了乌丁,结束了帕特里亚德弗里利人的独立.
de: Troops of the Republic of Venice capture Udine, ending the independence of the Patria del Friuli.

t: 维特科夫山战役(Battle of Vítkov Hill),由扬·日日克所指挥的捷克胡塞斯部…
te: Battle of Vítkov Hill, decisive victory of Czech Hussite forces commanded by Jan Žižka against Crusade army led by Sigi…
dz: 维特科夫山战役(Battle of Vítkov Hill),由扬·日日克所指挥的捷克胡塞斯部队对由神圣罗马皇帝西吉斯蒙德所领导的十字军的决定性胜利.
de: Battle of Vítkov Hill, decisive victory of Czech Hussite forces commanded by Jan Žižka against Crusade army led by Sigismund, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 8.8–9.4 Caldera地震震动了智利的阿塔卡马地区,引发了智利,夏威夷和日本的海啸.
te: The 8.8–9.4 Caldera earthquake shakes Chile's Atacama Region causing tsunami in Chile, Hawaii, and Japan.
dz: 8.8–9.4 Caldera地震震动了智利的阿塔卡马地区,引发了智利,夏威夷和日本的海啸.
de: The 8.8–9.4 Caldera earthquake shakes Chile's Atacama Region causing tsunami in Chile, Hawaii, and Japan.

t: 紫禁城建成后，北京正式定为明朝首都。
te: Beijing is officially designated the capital of the Ming dynasty when the Forbidden City is completed.
dz: 紫禁城建成后，北京正式定为明朝首都。
de: Beijing is officially designated the capital of the Ming dynasty when the Forbidden City is completed.

t: 英格兰的亨利五世与他岳父法国国王查理六世一起进入了巴黎.
te: Henry V of England enters Paris alongside his father-in-law King Charles VI of France.
dz: 英格兰的亨利五世与他岳父法国国王查理六世一起进入了巴黎.
de: Henry V of England enters Paris alongside his father-in-law King Charles VI of France.
